source: Shipped Flutter UI (package `rectify`) rendered from real widgets, routes, and state. No marketing mockups, no fabricated screens.
captureMethod: flutter test widget harness on the host VM: RepaintBoundary.toImage(pixelRatio: 3) -> ui.ImageByteFormat.png -> File. Demo mode (offline, no network) drives a canonical 6-event calculation through the real calculation_flow controller and go_router routes.
network: none (demo mode is fully offline; no network calls, no HTTP)
captionPlanSource: CURRENT post-Appeeky five-frame store story. Captions are owner-composited overlays, NOT baked into these raw frames.

refresh.reason: Re-captured from the current simplified shipped Settings and in-app Privacy screens. Same throwaway /tmp widget-test harness, iPhone 6.7" geometry, offline Demo-mode method, and RepaintBoundary.toImage(pixelRatio: 3) as the original set; only frames 03 and 05 changed.

frames.title: Problem hook
frames.shippedWidgets: TimeWindowScreen with unknown-birth-time controls and search-window copy
frames.shows: The unknown-birth-time entry point: 'Do you know an approximate birth time?' with 'I have an approximate time' / 'I have no idea', an approximate time, a search window, and the derived range copy.
frames.intendedCaption: Don't know your exact birth time?

frames.title: Life events input
frames.shippedWidgets: LifeEventsScreen populated with the canonical offline demo event set
frames.shows: Populated life-events list with education, relocation, career, relationship, and child milestones plus Add event and Continue affordances.
frames.intendedCaption: Add the life events you remember.

frames.title: The result
frames.shippedWidgets: ResultScreen hero card + confidence bar + alternate candidates + DEMO pill
frames.shows: Most probable birth time 7:14 AM, Gemini Rising, 78% confidence, alternate candidates (7:42 AM 61%, 8:03 AM 44%), DEMO badge, 'See how we got this' CTA.
frames.intendedCaption: Estimate your birth time and rising sign.

frames.title: The evidence
frames.shippedWidgets: EvidenceScreen per-event match cards with STRONG/MODERATE/WEAK strength chips
frames.shows: 'Why 7:14 AM? 4 of 6 events strongly supported this time.' Per-event rows: Education (STRONG), Relocation (STRONG), Marriage/Partnership (MODERATE), Career change (MODERATE), Birth of child (WEAK).
frames.intendedCaption: See the evidence behind every candidate.

frames.title: Private & offline demo
frames.shippedWidgets: SettingsScreen: Demo mode toggle, Time format, Delete all data, bottom nav
frames.shows: Demo mode toggle ON ('Run calculations with sample data (free, no network)'), 12h/24h time format, 'Delete all data' ('Removes all calculations and events from this device. Cannot be undone').
frames.intendedCaption: Private by default. Try it free, offline.

shareTextPayload.privacySafe: Contains only estimated time + rising sign + confidence + brand. No birth date, no birthplace, no life events, no PII.
shareTextPayload.exactText:
My TrueRise rectification result:
7:14 AM · Gemini Rising · 78% confidence

Calculated with TrueRise — birth-time rectification

limitations: The native OS share sheet cannot be captured from the host `flutter test` harness (no platform share-sheet surface in the binding). Frame 04 therefore shows the shipped in-app 'Share result' button; the exact text payload the share action emits is recorded verbatim in shareTextPayload.exactText.
These are raw device-resolution captures with NO marketing caption overlays or device bezels. Compositing captions (docs/store-listing-en.md §5) and any framing is owner work.

Times/signs/percentages come from the canonical offline DEMO dataset, not a live calculation. The DEMO badge is visible in-frame on the result and evidence screens, matching the honest, probabilistic framing required for store review.
iPhone 6.7" portrait only. The same harness can emit a Play / other-size variant by changing the view geometry if a second set is later required.
